Ведите пальцем по буквам колеса — получи:
Slide a finger over the letters of the wheel to make a word. You can also tap the letters one by one and then **the centre of the wheel**. The game takes **Russian nouns in their dictionary form** of 3 letters or more: «стол», «ножницы». Each letter of the set is used once.

A set is **finished** when all common words of 4 letters or more and 70 % of the three-letter ones are found. The top shows how many words of each length are left. **Rare** words do not count towards it, but they pay double.

Words bring **bricks**: longer words and rare letters pay more, a word new to the album pays triple. Spend bricks on **houses**: residents pay tax, even while the game is closed. **Upgrades** give hints, chests and multipliers.

Long words and the album open **quarters**. With the Old town you can start a **New town**: fame adds to bricks and tax for good, and the album stays.

A real word the game does not know? The **«Not in the dictionary?»** button: the model checks it when there is a network.
Словарь игры — нарицательные существител: The dictionary of the game is the common nouns of Russian in their dictionary form. It lives on the phone in full and works without a network. Common words are the most frequent in everyday speech; you find them to finish a set. The rest are rare and pay double.
